entries.head: traceql
entries.message: traceql: %s comparison RHS must be a literal array, got %T
entries.rationale: Defensive: every array comparison reaching here was folded by ast/rewrite.go's foldArrayComparison, whose only constructing return is `&BinaryOperation{Op: rule.array, LHS: attrL, RHS: merged}` with merged a staticMerge array Static, so a non-literal RHS is unreachable from a parseable query for any of the four arrayFoldRules operators (OpIn, OpNotIn, OpRegexMatchAny, OpRegexMatchNone).

entries.head: traceql
entries.message: traceql: %s comparison LHS must be an attribute reference, got %T
entries.rationale: Defensive: every array comparison reaching here was folded by ast/rewrite.go's foldArrayComparison, whose only constructing return takes its LHS from attrLiteralOperands and so is always an Attribute, for any of the four arrayFoldRules operators (OpIn, OpNotIn, OpRegexMatchAny, OpRegexMatchNone); a non-attribute LHS is unreachable from a parseable query.
